INSERT INTO user_settings (user_id, auto_approve_prs, created_at, updated_at)
             VALUES (?, ?,
                     DATE_FORMAT(NOW(3), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ'),
                     DATE_FORMAT(NOW(3), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ'))
             ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
                 auto_approve_prs = VALUES(auto_approve_prs),
                 updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
